name: Providenciales International Airport (Howard Hamilton International)

notes: Read: TCI Airports Authority page 'Providenciales International Airport' (https://tciairports.com/airports/providenciales-international-airport, no date shown), which states 'The Providenciales Airport IATA Code is PLS'. The same page also gives 9,199 ft (2,804 m) and, after the Phase I extension, 2,807 m, so lengths differ slightly; 9,200 ft x 0.3048 = 2,804 m used. The TCI AIP (https://tciairports.com/aeronautical-information-publication-aip) is password protected for subscribers only, so AD 2 could not be read.
